dedupeText: retro soundtrack cover layout retro minimalist high contrast script typography yellow and black vintage media yellow header bar provides a bright anchor for the top edge central script title acts as the primary focal point white parenthetical text balances the large script above it boxed metadata at the bottom creates a stable base solid black background yellow top banner central script title wide tracked sans serif metadata

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, minimalist layout featuring a bright yellow header bar and a central script title on a black background, ideal for retro media covers.
excludeWhen: modern sans-serif only designs are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, three-tiered composition consisting of a thin yellow top banner, a large black central field containing a slanted script title and parenthetical subtitle, and a bottom metadata section with boxed text.
coreVisualRelationships: Yellow header bar provides a bright anchor for the top edge
Central script title acts as the primary focal point
White parenthetical text balances the large script above it
Boxed metadata at the bottom creates a stable base
coreInvariants: High-contrast black, yellow, and white color palette
Slanted, brush-style script for the main title
Wide-tracked lowercase sans-serif for secondary information

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The main title is centered horizontally and vertically within the black field, scaled to dominate the middle third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright yellow top banner acts as the initial visual entry point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the yellow top bar down to the large script title, then to the parenthetical subtitle, and finally to the boxed metadata at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space surrounds the central text to emphasize the high-contrast typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black background for the main body
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright yellow for the top banner and primary title text
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Red for the final word of the title and white for secondary text
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Pure black and highly saturated yellow create maximum visual impact.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A mix of casual brush script and geometric sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Main title uses a fluid, slanted brush script with connected lowercase letters
Secondary text uses a wide-tracked, geometric sans-serif
Metadata uses lowercase characters with extreme letter spacing
characterSpecificRedesigns: The exclamation point is stylized to match the brush stroke of the script
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a dynamic, organic script and a rigid, spaced-out geometric sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Thin white rectangular border for bottom metadata
Large quotation marks flanking the title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the slanted, casual brush feel of the main title
Provides the clean, geometric sans-serif look for secondary text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a solid black canvas with a thin bright yellow horizontal bar at the very top. Add a thin white rectangular frame at the bottom center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a large slanted yellow brush script title in the center. Add a red word at the end of the title. Place wide-tracked lowercase sans-serif text in the yellow bar, below the title in parentheses, and inside the bottom white frame.

verificationChecks: Is the top bar solid yellow?
Is the main title a slanted script?
Is the metadata text lowercase and wide-tracked?

adjustableVariables: Width of the top yellow bar
Color of the final word in the script title
Tracking amount for the sans-serif text
Thickness of the bottom white frame
mustRedesign: Do not use any specific brand logos
Do not use the exact phrasing from the reference
Ensure the script font is a generic brush style

mustAchieve: Sharp, clean edges on all graphic elements
High legibility of the script title
Consistent wide tracking for all sans-serif elements

postGenerationChecks: Check that the yellow bar is at the top edge
Verify the script title is slanted
Ensure the bottom text is inside a white box
Confirm the color palette is limited to black, yellow, white, and red
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid black background + yellow top banner + central script title + wide-tracked sans-serif metadata.
